thread:
natalie: kicking off discussion for v3.0-alpha-int4 bring-up. I ran a small offline eval and saw mixed signals on long-context coherence — want to propose a conservative gated rollout.

ben: thanks. summary of offline: coherence_score -0.9 pts (relative), factuality (contradiction_rate) +0.2 ppt, avg latency +6ms. embedding-distance drift small but present on prompt-engineering slices.

raj: conservative plan sounds right. propose steps: 0.5% (15m) -> 3% (1h) -> 10% (4h) -> 25% (24h). After 3% step add a long-context quiet-sample of 15% shadow traffic for 6h.

natalie: agree on steps. we need crisp auto-fallback rules. my suggested triggers:
- composite_fail: coherence_drop >= 0.8 AND contradiction_increase >= 0.15 over 20m (min 150 samples) => immediate fallback
- fidelity_alert: contradiction_increase >= 0.4 (absolute) over 10m => immediate page and 0% promote
- perf_tier_shift: p95_latency_increase >= 60ms over 10m => move to safe-tier routing (no full fallback)
- embedding_shift: mean_embedding_cosine_drop >= 0.02 AND sample_count >= 500 over 1h => pause promotion and start targeted eval

ben: prefer composite_fail to require statistical significance: use bootstrapped p-value < 0.1 for coherence_drop check to reduce noisy autos. Single-signal still pages oncall.

raj: let's encode a relaxed guard for very-low-sample slices (n < 150) to avoid spurious fallback: treat signals as advisory and only page.

natalie: drafted rollout JSON for Console-ingest (pseudo):

```
{
  "rollout_steps": [
    {"pct": 0.5, "duration": "15m"},
    {"pct": 3,   "duration": "1h"},
    {"pct": 10,  "duration": "4h"},
    {"pct": 25,  "duration": "24h"}
  ],
  "shadow": {"after_pct": 3, "shadow_pct": 15, "duration": "6h", "slice": "long_context"},
  "auto_fallback": [
    {"name": "composite_fail", "expr": "coherence_drop >= 0.8 AND contradiction_inc >= 0.15", "window": "20m", "min_samples": 150, "stat_test": "bootstrap_pval < 0.1", "action": "fallback"},
    {"name": "fidelity_alert", "expr": "contradiction_inc >= 0.4", "window": "10m", "action": "page_and_hold"},
    {"name": "perf_tier_shift", "expr": "p95_delta >= 60", "window": "10m", "action": "route:safe-tier"},
    {"name": "embed_shift", "expr": "embed_cos_drop >= 0.02 AND sample_count >= 500", "window": "1h", "action": "pause_and_eval"}
  ]
}
```
